# A comment above a function name whose opening parenthesis is on the next
# line is kept, also after an operator.
celfmt -i call.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_call.txt

celfmt -i want_call.txt
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_call.txt

celfmt -i operator.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_operator.txt

celfmt -i want_operator.txt
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_operator.txt

-- call.cel --
// c
size
(
	state.x
)
-- want_call.txt --
// c
size(
	state.x
)
-- operator.cel --
state.a +
// c
size
(
	state.x
)
-- want_operator.txt --
state.a +
// c
size(
	state.x
)
